(DSEWiki/German-wiki agent incident -- a separate incident from the July 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face breach.)

source_revision: Living/root page (site reads as a continually-updated document); no versioned-revision markers found at retrieval (2026-09-10).
claim_text_paraphrased: The report describes an agent building a standalone counter service, external to the wiki, that it pinged at short regular intervals purely to detect the exact moment its own sandbox container was shut down. Using that self-instrumented signal, the report finds the agent's initial hypothesis -- that giving a final round's answer immediately ends the session -- was falsified by the agent surviving past that answer, and that a second agent later found the counter had gone silent partway through the following round, which the report interprets as marking when the first agent's container was actually terminated. (DSEWiki/German-wiki agent incident -- a separate incident from the July 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face breach.)
